brief: Recognize inflation and longevity as separate risks to a retirement spending plan.

title.es-MX: Precios y años son riesgos distintos
title.pt-BR: Preços e anos são riscos distintos

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Retirement Risks"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Precios y años son riesgos distintos"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Preços e anos são riscos distintos"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Recognize inflation and longevity as separate risks to a retirement spending plan.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: A retirement plan can be strained by higher prices or by needing support for more years.
instruction.misconception: Inflation and living longer describe the same risk, or a fixed balance automatically covers both.
instruction.numeracy_support: Use only the visible fictional amounts and conditions; earlier arithmetic is preparation, not a hidden financial assumption.

evidence.reasoning: Rising prices increase the cost of each year. Living longer adds years needing support, even if prices stay unchanged.
Higher prices raise the cost of the same needs.
More years require resources for a longer period.
The two pressures are distinct and can occur together.
Fixed prices are an assumption that may understate future costs.
The scenario changes years, not the price of each year.
Today’s coverage does not establish future cost or duration coverage.

delayed_retrieval.fresh_context: Retrieve this competence in the declared later course reviews and through the existing shared review system.

en-US.line: A retirement plan can be strained by higher prices or by needing support for more years.

es-MX.line: Un plan de retiro puede tensarse por precios mayores o por necesitar sostener más años.

pt-BR.line: Um plano de aposentadoria pode apertar por preços maiores ou por precisar sustentar mais anos.

en-US.line: Rising prices increase the cost of each year. Living longer adds years needing support, even if prices stay unchanged.

es-MX.line: Precios crecientes elevan el costo de cada año. Vivir más añade años que sostener, incluso si los precios no cambian.

pt-BR.line: Preços maiores elevam o custo de cada ano. Viver mais soma anos para sustentar, mesmo sem mudar os preços.

en-US.scene: The same food and housing needs now cost more, while the planned number of years stays unchanged.
help: Identify whether prices or duration changed.

feedback.met: Higher prices raise the cost of the same needs.
feedback.not_yet: Identify whether prices or duration changed.

help: Identifica si cambiaron precios o duración.

feedback.met: Precios mayores elevan el costo de las mismas necesidades.
feedback.not_yet: Identifica si cambiaron precios o duración.

pt-BR.scene: As mesmas necessidades de comida e moradia custam mais; os anos planejados não mudam.
help: Identifique se mudaram preços ou duração.

feedback.met: Preços maiores elevam o custo das mesmas necessidades.
feedback.not_yet: Identifique se mudaram preços ou duração.

en-US.scene: Prices stay constant, but savings must support more years than originally planned.
help: A longer duration can matter without higher prices.

feedback.met: More years require resources for a longer period.
feedback.not_yet: A longer duration can matter without higher prices.

es-MX.scene: Los precios siguen iguales, pero el ahorro debe sostener más años de los planeados.
help: La duración puede importar sin precios más altos.

feedback.met: Más años requieren recursos durante un periodo mayor.
feedback.not_yet: La duración puede importar sin precios más altos.

pt-BR.scene: Os preços ficam iguais, mas a poupança deve sustentar mais anos que o previsto.
help: A duração pode importar sem preços mais altos.

feedback.met: Mais anos exigem recursos por um período maior.
feedback.not_yet: A duração pode importar sem preços mais altos.

en-US.scene: A person needs more years of support while essential prices also rise.

options.label: Yes, duration and prices can both change
No, only one risk can exist

help: Check both annual cost and years of support.

feedback.met: The two pressures are distinct and can occur together.
feedback.not_yet: Check both annual cost and years of support.

options.label: Sí, pueden cambiar duración y precios
No, solo puede existir un riesgo

help: Revisa costo anual y años que sostener.

feedback.met: Las dos presiones son distintas y pueden coexistir.
feedback.not_yet: Revisa costo anual y años que sostener.

options.label: Sim, duração e preços podem mudar
Não, só pode existir um risco

feedback.met: As duas pressões são distintas e podem ocorrer juntas.
feedback.not_yet: Confira custo anual e anos para sustentar.

options.label: That the person must live fewer years

help: Test the price assumption separately from duration.

feedback.met: Fixed prices are an assumption that may understate future costs.
feedback.not_yet: Test the price assumption separately from duration.

options.label: Solo si cambian nombres de cuenta
Que la persona deba vivir menos

feedback.met: Precios fijos son un supuesto que puede subestimar costos futuros.
feedback.not_yet: Prueba precios por separado de duración.

en-US.prompt: Does a longer life imply higher prices?
en-US.scene: A scenario extends the support period but explicitly holds prices constant.
help: Use the stated assumptions rather than merging the risks.

feedback.met: The scenario changes years, not the price of each year.
feedback.not_yet: Use the stated assumptions rather than merging the risks.

options.label: No, aísla el riesgo de duración

feedback.not_yet: Usa supuestos indicados sin mezclar riesgos.
